services.name: Parasail
services.desc: Join us for our safe, exhilarating family adventure, flying up to 600 or 800 feet. About Three Generations is Just Routine Almost every day we see the kids, mom and dad, and a set of grandparents board a KrantzKraft parasailing boat to launch a family adventure. It is safe, fun, and EXHILARATING! We require that you weigh at least 60 pounds and be prepared to smile so much your face hurts. We’ve Been Taking Families Parasailing Safely Since 1986 Every launch and retrieval takes place from inside a boat custom designed for this activity. Aloft, the views of Oahu are spectacular. Your photos All Ages • Fly up to 600 or 800 Feet!

services.name: Jet Ski
services.desc: At H2O Sports you ride on state-of-the-art Yamaha VX110 Personal Watercraft in a protected area of calm, lovely Maunalua Bay. About Every Year, Nice New WaveRunners! At H2O Sports, you ride on state-of-the-art Yamaha VX110 Personal Watercraft in a protected area of calm, lovely Maunalua Bay. New skis are almost always safer skis, and we expand on the theme of wellbeing by having our course under the watchful eyes of US Coast Guard licensed Captains. Drive at 16; Ride With an Adult if You are Younger In keeping with our family-friendly tradition, even children under five are welcome on our All Ages to observe • Ages 16+ to drive • Ride on state-of-the-art Yamaha VX110 Personal Watercraft!

services.name: Bumper Tube
services.desc: You are on your tummy, your face just inches from the water and the wake of a jet ski. About Bumper Tube: Want Wetter? Try Submerging! You are on your tummy, your face just inches from the water and the wake of a jet ski. Sound wet enough? Whether you are in Maunalua Bay or the Hawai‘i Kai Lagoon, our advice is simple: Don’t let go! The result will be momentary, total immersion in Hawaiian waters! This Can Be a Family Experience A lot of kids challenge their elders to join in. This is one of the reasons we want even would-be observers to wear a bathing suit. Want Something Slightly Dryer? All Ages • Just inches from the water!
